title: Organic Food: Healthy and Local?
text:
Organic food is food that is produced without using chemicals.
People buy organic food because they think it is healthy. But is it healthy for the planet?
Most people think that organic food is grown by small local farmers. But today, giant food companies like Coca Cola also grow organic food. Many of these big companies still use conventional farming methods that are very bad for the environment, even if the food they grow is more "healthy."

Another problem is that a lot of organic food actually comes from faraway countries. Gases from the trucks and airplanes that we use to transport our groceries across continents and countries are a major cause of global warming.
What can you do if you want to buy organic food, but you also want to help the environment?
One solution is to support your local farmer and encourage him to grow organic food. You can also join a community agriculture program. Members help pay for seeds, fertilizer, water, equipment, etc., and in return, the farm provides a healthy supply of fresh food.
So the answer is to buy organic, but also buy local!

multiple_choice.question: What is one way to help the environment?
options: Buy organic food from faraway countries.

title: A Green Box: Is It Organic?
text:
Emma is at the supermarket with her dad. She wants some cereal for breakfast.

“Look! This box is green. It has a tree and the words “100% natural.” Is it organic?” she asks.

“Let’s read the label,” says Dad. “A picture of a tree does not mean the food is organic.”

They look at another box. It has a small circle with the words “USDA Organic.”

“This is an official seal in the United States,” Dad explains. “Farmers and food companies must follow special rules to use it.”

“Does it mean all the ingredients are organic?” asks Emma.

“Not always. For cereal with this seal, at least 95% of the ingredients must be organic. Water and salt do not count.”

Emma looks at the two boxes again.

“So, a green box and a nice picture are not enough!”

“That’s right. Read the words, too.”

Before they buy the cereal, Emma checks one more thing: the price!

title: How to Stay Safe During an Earthquake
text: How to Stay Safe During an Earthquake Earthquakes can happen without warning. It is important to know what to do before, during, and after an earthquake. First, stay calm. Do not run or panic. Next, get under a strong table or desk. If there is no table, sit next to an inside wall and protect your head and neck with your arms. Then, stay away from windows, mirrors, and tall furniture. These objects can break or fall. After that, wait until the shaking stops. Do not use elevators during an earthquake. Next, check yourself and other people for injuries. Help others if you can. Then, listen to the radio or check official information on your phone for emergency updates. After that, if the building is damaged, leave carefully and go to an open area away from buildings, trees, and power lines. Finally, stay with your family or friends and follow the instructions of emergency workers. Vocabulary earthquake warning strong injury damaged power line

title: Marjane Satrapi's Rights and Responsibilities
text: Marjane Satrapi's Rights and Responsibilities Marjane Satrapi grew up in Iran during a time of major political change. When she was a child, new laws affected many people's daily lives. title: Hawaii vs. Puerto Rico
text: Hawaii vs. Puerto Rico Which Island Destination Is Better? Many people dream about visiting tropical islands. Two popular destinations are Hawaii and Puerto Rico. Both places have beautiful beaches, warm weather, and interesting cultures, but they are different in several ways. Hawaii is larger than Puerto Rico and has more famous volcanoes. It is also farther from Guatemala. Puerto Rico is closer to Guatemala, so flights are often shorter. Puerto Rico is generally more Spanish-speaking than Hawaii. For many Guatemalans, Puerto Rico may feel more familiar because Spanish is the main language. In contrast, English is more common in Hawaii. When it comes to nature, Hawaii has some of the most spectacular landscapes in the world. Its volcanoes are more impressive than those of many other destinations. Puerto Rico, however, has one of the most beautiful rainforests in the Caribbean, El Yunque. Both destinations have excellent beaches. Some travelers think Hawaii has the best surfing beaches, while others prefer Puerto Rico because it is less expensive than Hawaii. In general, Hawaii is one of the most expensive vacation destinations in the United States. Food is another interesting difference. Puerto Rican food is spicier than Hawaiian food in some cases, while Hawaiian cuisine is more influenced by Asian cultures. In the end, neither destination is clearly better than the other. Hawaii may be the most exciting choice for travelers who love volcanoes and surfing. Puerto Rico may be the most convenient option for people who want a Caribbean experience in a Spanish-speaking environment.

title: Digital Credit Cards vs. Physical Credit Cards
text: Digital Credit Cards vs. Physical Credit Cards Many people use credit cards to pay for products and services. Today, customers can choose between digital credit cards and physical credit cards. Both options are convenient, but they have important differences. A digital credit card is stored on a smartphone or smartwatch. A physical credit card is a plastic card that people carry in their wallets. Digital credit cards are generally more convenient than physical credit cards because people usually carry their phones everywhere. They are also faster than physical cards in many stores because customers can simply tap their devices. On the other hand, physical credit cards are more widely accepted than digital cards in some places. Not every business accepts digital payments. Physical cards are also easier to use than digital cards for people who are not comfortable with technology. In terms of security, many experts believe that digital credit cards are safer than physical cards because they often use biometric verification such as fingerprints or facial recognition. If a wallet is stolen, a thief may use a physical card more easily. However, if a phone is lost, users can often lock it remotely. Digital cards are also more environmentally friendly than physical cards because they do not require plastic. Physical cards, however, may be the most practical option when a phone battery is dead. For frequent travelers, digital wallets are often the most convenient payment method because they allow people to carry several cards on one device. However, many consumers still believe that physical cards are the most reliable option in emergencies. In conclusion, neither option is perfect. Digital credit cards are generally faster, safer, and more convenient, while physical credit cards are often more practical and more widely accepted. The best choice depends on the user's needs.

title: Backstreet Boys vs. NSYNC: Which Boy Band Was More Successful?
text: Backstreet Boys vs. NSYNC: Which Boy Band Was More Successful? In the late 1990s and early 2000s, Backstreet Boys and NSYNC were two of the biggest boy bands in the world. Backstreet Boys sold more than 100 million records worldwide. NSYNC sold about 70 million records worldwide. Therefore, Backstreet Boys were more successful than NSYNC in total record sales. However, NSYNC released one of the fastest-selling albums in music history. Their album No Strings Attached sold about 2.4 million copies in its first week in the United States. That was more than any other album at the time. Backstreet Boys had more international success than NSYNC. Their music was popular in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. They also completed larger world tours and performed in more countries. When it comes to awards, both groups were very successful. Backstreet Boys received more than 200 awards, while NSYNC won over 150 awards. Backstreet Boys were more recognized internationally, but NSYNC was often more popular among teenagers in the United States. Another important difference is the members' careers after the groups slowed down. Justin Timberlake became the most successful solo artist from either band. He won multiple Grammy Awards and sold millions of albums as a solo singer. Today, Backstreet Boys are still performing together more than 30 years after they were formed. They are one of the longest-lasting boy bands in pop music history. Many fans think they have the strongest vocal harmonies, while others believe NSYNC had the most exciting dance performances. In the end, Backstreet Boys were more successful in total sales, but NSYNC had one of the biggest albums ever released. Both groups remain among the most famous boy bands of all time. title: Australia vs. Canada: Job Opportunities Abroad
text: Australia vs. Canada: Job Opportunities Abroad Many Latin Americans consider Australia and Canada when looking for better job opportunities abroad. Canada is often more popular because it has immigration programs for skilled workers and a large multicultural population. Nearly 23% of Canada's population consists of immigrants, so newcomers can meet people from many different cultures. On the other hand, Australia usually offers higher salaries in some industries, especially construction, mining, and engineering. About 31% of Australia's population was born overseas, which is a higher proportion than Canada's. This also makes Australia a very multicultural country. Canada is generally colder than Australia, but many people think it is easier to settle there because of its immigrant-friendly policies. For many newcomers, Canada is one of the most accessible countries for starting a new life. Australia is warmer than Canada and has a relaxed outdoor lifestyle that attracts many immigrants. However, it is farther from Latin America, so visiting family can be more difficult and expensive. Canada has larger Latin American communities, while Australia has some of the highest wages in the world. Both countries are safer than many Latin American countries and offer a high quality of life. Choosing between them depends on personal priorities. If someone wants the easiest immigration process, Canada may be the best option. If someone prefers a warmer climate and potentially higher earnings, Australia could be the better choice.

title: A Big Problem in Space
text: A Big Problem in Space Three astronauts travel to space on Apollo 13. Two days into the trip, an oxygen tank explodes. It is a serious emergency. The spacecraft loses electricity, water, and air. The astronauts are far away from Earth and are in great danger. In Houston, Texas, flight director Gene Kranz calls his entire team to Mission Control. He needs to rally the troops. The engineers are worried and scared, but Gene stays calm. He explains the situation clearly. He tells them, “Do not panic, and do not guess. Look at what still works and find solutions. Our only job is to bring our team home.” The team works together immediately: - One group calculates a new flight path around the Moon. - Another group finds ways to save battery power and water. - In a special room, engineers use simple items like tape, plastic bags, and socks to build an air filter for the astronauts. Everyone works day and night without stopping. After four days, the three astronauts land safely in the Pacific Ocean. Gene Kranz rallies the troops, and great teamwork saves three lives. title: Cooking with Loroco
text: Loroco is a special flower used in Central American food. In Guatemala, many people use loroco to prepare delicious dishes. It has a strong smell and a special flavor. One popular dish is chicken with loroco. To prepare it, we need some chicken, some loroco, an onion, and a few tomatoes. We also need a little salt and some cream. We don't need much oil, but we need a lot of flavor! Loroco is also excellent with cheese. Some people make pupusas with cheese and loroco, and others add it to soups, rice, or sauces. Are there many ingredients in these dishes? Sometimes! But you don't need any difficult ingredients to enjoy loroco. With a few vegetables, some cheese, and a little loroco, you can prepare something delicious. For many families, loroco is more than an ingredient. It is part of traditional food and a flavor that makes a meal special.

title: Translating adresses
text: In Guatemala, addresses are special. In Guatemala City, people use words like calle, avenida, and zona. A common address is 6a Avenida, Zona 1. A calle is a street and an avenida is an avenue. But when we speak English, we usually keep these names in Spanish. Outside the capital, addresses change. You can see words like municipio, aldea, cantón, and colonia. These words are not easy to translate. The United States uses words like city, town, village, drive, or lane. They are not the same thing. For this reason, do not translate your local address. Keep the original words so people can find your home. Learning English is not only about new words. It is also about learning how different people live and organize their communities. Every country has a unique way to show the way.

title: The Man on the Green Cover
text:
Look at this man. His name is Al-Khwarizmi. He lived a long time ago. He is the father of algebra.

Today, his face is on old stamps. But in Latin America, his face is very famous for a different reason: the green cover of the Álgebra de Baldor!

Right now, students all over the world open their notebooks. They look at the green book. They read math problems. They write numbers, letters, and equations.

For example, they can write: 50 + 50 = 100. They say, “Fifty plus fifty equals one hundred.” They can also write: 100 - 25 = 75. They say, “One hundred minus twenty-five equals seventy-five.”

In algebra, students also use letters. For example: x + 20 = 100. What is x? The answer is 80! Eighty plus twenty equals one hundred.

Students also practice other math signs: + means plus, - means minus, × means times, ÷ means divided by, and = means equals.

Sometimes students say, “Oh no, more homework!” Al-Khwarizmi is quiet on the cover, but his math is in every school. Students practice numbers and equations every day!

options: Because it appears on the cover of Álgebra de Baldor.

Because he lives in Guatemala today.

true_false.statement: Al-Khwarizmi is known as the father of algebra.
The math sign "+" means minus.
In algebra, students practice both numbers and letters.
